{{Top|leg}}
'''Flowstones''' were composed of sheetlike deposits of [[Calcite/Legends|calcite]] formed where [[Water/Legends|water]] flowed down the walls or along the floors of a cave. They were typically found in "solution, or limestone caves, where they were the most common cave formation. However, they could have formed in any type of cave where water entered that had picked up dissolved [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]].

The subterranean [[Coway]] tribes, on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]], made [[Spear/Legends|spears]] and other implements from flowstone.
